model.network: No network jitter; publicSnapshot/publicEvent/unpackEvent/perspective/unpackGame from the checkpoint.

instrumentation: Real served app and immutable Game/Renderer. The original app simulation is suspended; controlled scenarios use canonical cards. Context readback is fixture-only. HUD is the initial app state.
limits: This is controlled combat QA, not an online match or collection/detail QA. No material, gameplay or statistics are changed. Browser capture is not proof of publication.

cases.fixture: Canonical cards and real Game.attack/step; stationary targets use the engine stun status. Tower positions and card values are unchanged.
